answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch on the ridge unless refreshed by genuine work, worn down like a reef by the surf. A fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight thins to nothing the moment it stops contributing on its lonely island. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill.
